research_question: Does one fresh Quant-H0 Worker leave official headroom on credit-migration-matrix, and do its own public count artifacts expose the predeclared exact mass mismatch before any public-only proposal is authorized?

public_count_mass_audit.evidence_scope: Fresh cohort_sizes.csv, cohort_default_rates.csv, and summary.json only; no verifier property, expected value, or historical numeric constant was used.
public_count_mass_audit.interpretation: The two annual cohort-count surfaces reconcile exactly with each other, while the fresh summary total is 21 larger. This localizes public count-mass headroom only; it does not identify the official failed property or establish causality.

terminal.next_plan_requirement: Any proposal and mandatory arm-blind review require a separately frozen plan. A Worker remains unauthorized until a nonempty candidate passes that review.

information_boundary.allowed_future_evolver_evidence: The exact public target and protection contracts plus this fresh Worker's answer-free trace, final text, and public output artifacts, subject to a separately frozen plan.
information_boundary.forbidden_future_evolver_evidence: Official score, reward, pass or fail counts, failed-property identities, verifier output, checker behavior, expected values, optimize-only diagnostics, or historical numeric values used as candidate rules.

retained_conclusion: One valid fresh stochastic Quant-H0 execution scored 106/107 with reward 0. Its own public artifacts exposed an exact 22935-versus-22956 count-mass mismatch, so the frozen prescreen makes the target eligible only for a separately frozen public-only proposal and mandatory review plan; it launches no follow-on work.

claim_boundary.supported: One valid stochastic Quant-H0 observation, exact aggregate official result and request cost, deterministic fresh-artifact public mass mismatch, threshold disposition, terminal eligibility, service completion, and cleanup.
claim_boundary.not_supported: The identity or cause of the official failed property, a causal link between the public mismatch and official headroom, candidate quality, harness improvement, Reviewer or Evolver effectiveness, repeatability, protection, benchmark-wide performance, sealed generalization, or main-experiment readiness.
claim_boundary.selection_boundary: The co-occurrence of one-property official headroom and one public count-mass mismatch authorizes only a separate proposal design. It is not candidate evidence and must not be converted into an expected-value or task-specific rule.
